---
title: "Subfigures in Margin (Mermaid)"
papersize: us-letter
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        # Should have note() wrapping quarto_super for margin subfigure placement
        - ['#note\(', 'quarto_super']
        - []
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        # Subfigure labels, main figure label, and subfigure numbering
        - ['Figure 1', 'MERMAID-PANEL', '\(a\) Flow', '\(b\) Sequence']
        - []
      ensurePdfTextPositions:
        - # Subfigure panel in margin
          - subject: "Flow"
            relation: rightOf
            object: "This tests"
          - subject: "Sequence"
            relation: rightOf
            object: "This tests"
          # Flow is above Sequence (vertical ordering of subfigures)
          - subject: "Flow"
            relation: above
            object: "Sequence"
          # Main figure caption is below Sequence (caption at bottom for figures)
          - subject: "Sequence"
            relation: above
            object: "MERMAID-PANEL"
        - []
      noErrors: default
---

This tests subfigures (panel figures) placed in the margin using mermaid diagrams.

::: {#fig-margin-mermaid .column-margin layout-ncol=1}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-mermaid-flow
%%| fig-cap: "Flow Chart"
%%| fig-width: 1.5
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B[End]
```

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-mermaid-seq
%%| fig-cap: "Sequence Diagram"
%%| fig-width: 1.5
sequenceDiagram
    A->>B: Hello
```

MERMAID-PANEL: Two mermaid subfigures in margin
:::

Reference to @fig-margin-mermaid shows the panel.

More text in the main column to show the layout alongside the margin subfigures.
